summary.text: Mark Proulx is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 15 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8, 2026 Republican primary.
Proulx's career includes owning Tactical Protection Services and Firehouse Emergency Training and serving with Nashua Fire Rescue.

paragraphs.text: Proulx won the general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 44 on November 6, 2018, and won Hillsborough 15 on November 8, 2022 and November 5, 2024.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignment for 2023-2024 as the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee, and for 2019-2020 as the House Executive Departments and Administration Committee.
Ballotpedia also lists Executive Departments and Administration committee service in the 2011-2012, 2015 and 2017 legislative sessions.
